proposed_core_edits.reason: The exact exposure extrema use the declared reference-period normalization, so that assumption must be recorded in the theorem's dependency metadata.

proposed.justification: The theorem gives an exact minimax value and a complete optimizer description in the sparse phase where regular PPML intervals fail most severely.
proposed.gap: Evans, Hansen, and Stark (2005) provide duality but no multivariate-Poisson value or optimizer characterization; Kabaila and Byrne (2001) treat one scalar Poisson mean.
proposed.consumer: Researchers with rare cohort-time outcomes can report the shortest uniformly honest deterministic connected interval policy and know precisely when nonzero tables permit extra length.
